# JustCall Documentation

> JustCall’s v2 REST APIs provide structured CRUD access to calls, SMS, contacts, agents, and webhooks—designed for seamless CRM integration and scalable communication workflows.

## API Reference: JustCall
- Calls
  - [List all calls](https://developer.justcall.io/reference/call_list_v21.md): Retrieve all calls linked to an account or refine the call selection as needed by utilizing the numerous query parameter fields.
  - [Get a call](https://developer.justcall.io/reference/call_get_v21.md): Utilize this endpoint for retrieval of data for a Call, including details such as duration, direction, status, timestamps, notes, and dispositions.
  - [Update a call](https://developer.justcall.io/reference/call_update_v21.md): This endpoint allows you to modify the notes, disposition, or rating associated with a completed call. Updates to ongoing or in-progress calls are not supported.
  - [Get call journey](https://developer.justcall.io/reference/call_get_journey_v21.md): This endpoint retrieves the journey details of a completed call. Journey data is generated only after a call has ended and is not available for ongoing or in-progress calls.
  - [Get voice agent data](https://developer.justcall.io/reference/call_get_voice_agent_v21.md): This endpoint provides the voice agent insights and metadata associated with a completed call. Voice agent data is processed after the call ends and is not available for ongoing or in-progress calls.
  - [Download call recording](https://developer.justcall.io/reference/call_recording_download_v21.md): This endpoint allows you to download the recording of a completed call. Recordings are generated only after the call has ended and cannot be accessed for ongoing or in-progress calls.
- Contacts
  - [List all contacts](https://developer.justcall.io/reference/contacts_list_v21.md): Retrieve all contacts present in your account or filter the contacts based on one or more query parameters.
  - [Get a contact](https://developer.justcall.io/reference/contact_get_v21.md): Utilize this endpoint to retrieve data related to a specific Contact using the "id" of the contact
  - [Create contact](https://developer.justcall.io/reference/create_contact_v21.md): Utilize this endpoint to add a new contact to JustCall’s ‘Contacts’ section.
  - [Update contact](https://developer.justcall.io/reference/update_contact_v21.md): Utilize this endpoint to update an existing contact present in JustCall’s ‘Contacts’ section.
  - [Update contact status](https://developer.justcall.io/reference/update_contact_status_v21.md): Utilize this endpoint to update the contact’s status.
  - [Delete contact](https://developer.justcall.io/reference/delete_contact_v21.md): Utilize this endpoint to delete a specific contact from your JustCall account using the ‘id’ or the ‘contact_number’ of the contact. Send ‘across_team’ as true to perform the action for all agents in…
  - [Bulk add contacts to blacklist](https://developer.justcall.io/reference/bulk_add_contacts_to_blacklist_v21.md): Utilize this endpoint to add one or more contact(s) to DND, DNM, and/or Blacklist. Invalid and duplicate numbers will be skipped, and the response will indicate added, updated, failed and skipped…
  - [List blacklist contacts](https://developer.justcall.io/reference/list_blacklist_contacts_v21.md): Utilize this endpoint to list blacklisted contacts based on one or more query parameters.
- Phone Numbers
  - [List all phone numbers](https://developer.justcall.io/reference/phone_number_list_v21.md): Utilize this endpoint to fetch a list of all the phone numbers added to your JustCall account and to filter a set of numbers via the query parameters.
  - [Get a phone number](https://developer.justcall.io/reference/phone_number_get_v21.md): Get data for a specific phone number or check it's current availability status using this endpoint by sending the id of the phone number.
  - [Detect incoming number](https://developer.justcall.io/reference/phone_number_detect_v21.md): Utilize this endpoint to detect if an incoming call is from a Mobile/Landline/VOIP number. Please contact dev@justcall.io to enable this particular API for your account. Additional charges may apply…
- RCS
  - [List all messages](https://developer.justcall.io/reference/rcs_messages_list_v21.md): Retrieve RCS messages for an RCS sender, or refine the selection with the query parameter fields.
  - [Get a message](https://developer.justcall.io/reference/rcs_message_get_v21.md): Use this endpoint to access RCS message data, including direction, associated agent and delivery status.
  - [Send message](https://developer.justcall.io/reference/rcs_message_send_v21.md): Send an RCS message from an RCS sender (`rcs_phone_id`). Supports freeform body, media, or an approved template. Do not combine `template_id` with `media_url`: when `template_id` is present, the…
  - [List all templates](https://developer.justcall.io/reference/rcs_message_templates_list_v21.md): Fetch RCS templates added to your JustCall account. Templates are company-scoped and are not tied to a specific JustCall number.
  - [Create a card template](https://developer.justcall.io/reference/rcs_message_templates_create_card_v21.md): Create an RCS card template using simplified fields (`title`, `body`, `media_url`, `actions`). Supports `variables` and SMS fallback fields.
  - [Create a carousel template](https://developer.justcall.io/reference/rcs_message_templates_create_carousel_v21.md): Create an RCS carousel template with a required non-empty `cards` array. Supports `variables` and SMS fallback fields.
  - [Create a media template](https://developer.justcall.io/reference/rcs_message_templates_create_media_v21.md): Create an RCS media template with a required `media_url` and optional caption `body`. Supports `variables` and SMS fallback fields.
  - [Create a text template](https://developer.justcall.io/reference/rcs_message_templates_create_text_v21.md): Create an RCS text template. Use `variables` when the body includes JC placeholders such as `{{firstname}}`. Optional SMS fallback is supported via `fallback_enabled`, `fallback_text`, and…
  - [List RCS senders](https://developer.justcall.io/reference/rcs_phones_list_v21.md): Retrieve RCS sender agents linked to your JustCall account. Use the returned `id` as `rcs_phone_id` when sending or listing RCS messages.
- Special Dates
  - [List all special dates](https://developer.justcall.io/reference/special_dates_list_v21.md): Fetch a list of special dates added to your JustCall account. Use query parameters to paginate and search by name.
  - [Create a special date](https://developer.justcall.io/reference/special_dates_create_v21.md): Create a special date by sending a name, timezone, and one or more time slots.
  - [Delete a special date](https://developer.justcall.io/reference/special_dates_delete_v21.md): Delete a special date by sending its id.
  - [Get a special date](https://developer.justcall.io/reference/special_dates_get_v21.md): Get data for a specific special date by sending its id.
  - [Update a special date](https://developer.justcall.io/reference/special_dates_update_v21.md): Update a special date by sending its id along with the name, timezone, and/or time slots to change.
- SMS
  - [List all texts](https://developer.justcall.io/reference/texts_list_v21.md): Retrieve all text messages linked to an account or refine the message selection as needed by utilizing the various query parameter fields.
  - [Get a text](https://developer.justcall.io/reference/texts_get_v21.md): Use this endpoint to access SMS data, including information like direction, associated agent number and delivery status.
  - [Check reply](https://developer.justcall.io/reference/texts_checkreply_v21.md): Check the response for a specific SMS sent to a user by providing the contact's phone number and, optionally, the JustCall number. This endpoint returns the most recent inbound SMS from the…
  - [Send SMS/MMS](https://developer.justcall.io/reference/texts_new_v21.md): Utilize this endpoint to send SMS messages via the JustCall API and leverage it for setting up SMS automation's in a third-party tool as well.
  - [List all tags](https://developer.justcall.io/reference/texts_tags_list_v21.md): Utilise this endpoint to fetch a list of all the tags added to your JustCall account.
  - [Get a tag](https://developer.justcall.io/reference/texts_tags_get_v21.md): Get details of a specific tag by sending its id.
  - [Create a tag](https://developer.justcall.io/reference/texts_tags_create_v21.md): Utilise this endpoint to create a tag in your JustCall account.
  - [Delete a tag](https://developer.justcall.io/reference/texts_tags_delete_v21.md): Delete a specific tag by sending its id.
  - [List all threads](https://developer.justcall.io/reference/texts_threads_list_v21.md): Utilize this endpoint to fetch a list of all the threads added to your JustCall account.
  - [Get a thread](https://developer.justcall.io/reference/texts_threads_get_v21.md): Use this endpoint to access thread data, including messages associated with the thread and tags applied to the thread.
  - [Add tag to thread](https://developer.justcall.io/reference/add_tag_to_thread_v21.md): Utilize this endpoint to add a tag to the thread formed by a combination of a JustCall number and a contact number.
  - [Remove tag from thread](https://developer.justcall.io/reference/remove_tag_from_thread_v21.md): Use this endpoint to remove a tag from a thread or multiple threads associated with the same JustCall or contact number.
  - [List all groups](https://developer.justcall.io/reference/texts_groups_list_v21.md): Use this endpoint to fetch all SMS groups associated with a specific JustCall number.
  - [Get a group](https://developer.justcall.io/reference/texts_groups_get_v21.md): Use this endpoint to retrieve the details of a specific SMS group.
  - [Create a group](https://developer.justcall.io/reference/texts_groups_create_v21.md): Use this endpoint to create a new SMS group.
  - [Delete a group](https://developer.justcall.io/reference/texts_groups_delete_v21.md): Use this endpoint to delete a specific SMS group by its ID.
  - [List group messages](https://developer.justcall.io/reference/texts_groups_messages_list_v21.md): Use this endpoint to fetch messages sent in an SMS group.
  - [Get a group message](https://developer.justcall.io/reference/texts_groups_messages_get_v21.md): Use this endpoint to retrieve the details of a specific message sent in an SMS group.
  - [Send message in a group](https://developer.justcall.io/reference/texts_groups_messages_send_v21.md): Use this endpoint to send a new message in an SMS group.
  - [Add members to a group](https://developer.justcall.io/reference/texts_groups_members_add_v21.md): Use this endpoint to add one or more members (agents and/or contacts) to a specific SMS group.
  - [Remove members from a group](https://developer.justcall.io/reference/texts_groups_members_remove_v21.md): Use this endpoint to remove one or more members (agents and/or contacts) from a specific SMS group.
- Analytics
  - Calls
    - [Account analytics](https://developer.justcall.io/reference/call_account_analytics_v21.md): Utilize this endpoint to access detailed account analytics, including metrics such as total call volume, average ring time, total call duration, SLA performance, and connect and answer rates.
    - [Agent analytics](https://developer.justcall.io/reference/call_agent_analytics_v21.md): Utilize this endpoint to obtain comprehensive analytics for an agent, including specific metrics such as ring time, total call duration, SLA and connect and answer rates.
    - [Number analytics](https://developer.justcall.io/reference/call_number_analytics_v21.md): Utilize this endpoint to access detailed phone number analytics, including metrics such as total call volume, average ring time, total call duration, SLA performance, and connect and answer rates.
- User Groups
  - [List all user groups](https://developer.justcall.io/reference/users_groups_list_v21.md): Utilize this endpoint to fetch a list of all the user groups added to your JustCall account and to filter a set of user groups via the query parameters.
  - [Get a user group](https://developer.justcall.io/reference/users_group_get_v21.md): Get data for a specific user group using this endpoint by sending its id.
  - [Create a user group](https://developer.justcall.io/reference/users_group_create_v21.md): Create a user group using this endpoint by sending the group name, extension and member ids.
  - [Update a user group](https://developer.justcall.io/reference/users_group_update_v21.md): Update a user group using this endpoint by sending the user group id and the group name, extension and member ids.
  - [Add members to a user group](https://developer.justcall.io/reference/users_group_add_members_v21.md): Add members to a user group using this endpoint by sending the user group id and the member ids.
  - [Remove members from a user group](https://developer.justcall.io/reference/users_group_remove_members_v21.md): Remove members from a user group using this endpoint by sending the user group id and the member ids.
  - [Delete a user group](https://developer.justcall.io/reference/users_group_delete_v21.md): Delete a user group using this endpoint by sending the user group id.
- Users
  - [List all users](https://developer.justcall.io/reference/users_list_v21.md): Utilize this endpoint to fetch a list of all the users added to your JustCall account and to filter a set of users via the query parameters.
  - [Get a user](https://developer.justcall.io/reference/users_get_v21.md): Get data for a specific user using this endpoint by sending their id (agent_id can be found via the List all users API)
  - [Update user availability](https://developer.justcall.io/reference/update_user_availability_v21.md): Update the availability status of a user in JustCall.
- AI Voice Agents
  - [List all voice agents](https://developer.justcall.io/reference/list_voice_agents_v21.md): Utilize this endpoint to retrieve a list of all voice agents. This includes details such as voice agents names, actions, assigned numbers, and other metadata.
  - [Initiate a call](https://developer.justcall.io/reference/initiate_outbound_call_v21.md): Utilize this endpoint to trigger an outbound call from a configured AI Voice Agent to a specified contact number. Use Dynamic Variables to customize what the AI says or does during the conversation —…
- WhatsApp
  - [List all messages](https://developer.justcall.io/reference/whatsapp_messages_list_v21.md): Retrieve all WhatsApp messages linked to a JustCall account, or refine the message selection as required by utilizing the various query parameter fields.
  - [Get a message](https://developer.justcall.io/reference/whatsapp_message_get_v21.md): Use this endpoint to access WhatsApp message data, including information like direction, associated agent number and delivery status.
  - [Send message](https://developer.justcall.io/reference/whatsapp_message_send_v21.md): Use this endpoint to send WhatsApp messages from your JustCall WhatsApp integrated number. This can be used to send both templated and non-templated messages.
  - [List all templates](https://developer.justcall.io/reference/whatsapp_message_templates_list_v21.md): Use this endpoint to fetch a list of all the templates added to your JustCall WhatsApp integrated account.
  - [Check message reply](https://developer.justcall.io/reference/whatsapp_check_reply_v21.md): Use this endpoint to check if a WhatsApp reply has been received from a number on any of your JustCall numbers.

## API Reference: Sales Dialer
- Calls
  - [List all calls](https://developer.justcall.io/reference/sales_dialer_call_list_v21.md): Retrieve all Sales Dialer calls linked to an account or customize the call selection by leveraging the extensive set of query parameters available.
  - [Get a call](https://developer.justcall.io/reference/sales_dialer_call_get_v21.md): Utilize this endpoint to fetch comprehensive data for a Sales Dialer call, encompassing details like duration, call type, timestamps, notes, and dispositions.
- Campaigns
  - [List all campaigns](https://developer.justcall.io/reference/sales_dialer_campaign_list_v21.md): Retrieve all Sales Dialer campaigns present in an account or use the diverse set of available filters to extract campaigns based on specific conditions.
  - [Get a campaign](https://developer.justcall.io/reference/sales_dialer_campaign_get_v21.md): Access this endpoint to retrieve detailed information for a Sales Dialer campaign, including key details such as campaign type and default number.
  - [Create campaign](https://developer.justcall.io/reference/sales_dialer_create_campaign_v21.md): Utilize this endpoint to create a new Sales Dialer campaign for your account.
  - [Update campaign](https://developer.justcall.io/reference/sales_dialer_campaign_update_v21.md): Utilize this endpoint to update an existing Sales Dialer campaign in your account.
  - [List campaign contacts](https://developer.justcall.io/reference/sales_dialer_campaign_contacts_list_v21.md): Access this endpoint to fetch a list of all the contacts present in a particular Sales Dialer campaign or filter them based on their status or progress in the campaign.
  - [Add contact to a campaign](https://developer.justcall.io/reference/sales_dialer_add_contact_to_campaign_v21.md): Use this endpoint to add a contact to a campaign.
  - [Remove contact from a campaign](https://developer.justcall.io/reference/sales_dialer_remove_contact_from_campaign_v21.md): Utilize this endpoint to remove a particular contact from a campaign or remove all contacts from the campaign.
- Contacts
  - [List all contacts](https://developer.justcall.io/reference/sd_list_contact_v21.md): Access this endpoint to fetch a list of all the contacts present in your Sales Dialer account.
  - [Get a contact](https://developer.justcall.io/reference/sd_get_contact_v21.md): Access this endpoint to retrieve detailed information of a contact added to Sales Dialer.
  - [Create contact](https://developer.justcall.io/reference/sd_create_contact_v21.md): Utilize this endpoint to create a new contact in Sales Dialer.
  - [Update contact](https://developer.justcall.io/reference/sd_update_contact_v21.md): Utilize this endpoint to update a contact’s details in both default and custom fields using the ‘id’ of the contact.
  - [Delete contact](https://developer.justcall.io/reference/sd_delete_contact_v21.md): Utilize this endpoint to delete a specific contact from your Sales Dialer account using the ‘id’ of the contact.
  - [Bulk import contacts](https://developer.justcall.io/reference/bulk_import_contacts_v21.md): Utilize this endpoint to add or update contacts into Sales Dialer in bulk or add them to an existing campaign.
  - [Get bulk import status](https://developer.justcall.io/reference/bulk_import_contacts_status_v21.md): Utilize this endpoint to track the status of a bulk contact import request.
  - [Bulk Add Contacts to DNCA](https://developer.justcall.io/reference/sd_bulk_add_dnca_v21.md): Utilize this endpoint to add one or more contact(s) to the DNCA (Do Not Call Again) list. Invalid numbers will be skipped, and the response will indicate added and skipped numbers.
  - [List contact custom fields](https://developer.justcall.io/reference/sd_list_contact_custom_fields.md): Access this endpoint to retrieve custom fields added to the Sales Dialer Contacts Module
- Analytics
  - [Agent analytics](https://developer.justcall.io/reference/sales_dialer_agent_analytics_v21.md): Utilize this endpoint to obtain comprehensive analytics for a campaign or agent, including specific metrics such as pause time, total call duration, and connection rate.
